official_definition: Bombardment-D (When Advents/Attacks) You can reveal one card from the top of your deck. When that card is a "Machine Beast" family Spirit card, send one opposing Life to the Reserve. When it is a card with Advent, refresh this spirit. The revealed card is added to your hand.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Bombardment-D] or [Bombardment-D: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Bombardment-D]", "give [Bombardment-D]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
